_comment: Animation design for all 10 champions (passive/Q/W/E/ultimate) + locomotion. Phase timings mirror AbilityDefinition.startup/active/recovery. Import via Tools > Project D > Import Champion Animations. Clip names are what artists author in the DCC.

passive.animatorNotes: No dedicated clip; a shield-glow additive layer pulses on the shield socket as Resolve stacks. Blend intensity with stack count on an additive layer so it never interrupts locomotion.

abilityQ.animatorNotes: Right-to-left horizontal sword arc. Wind-up (0.18) draws the blade back over the shoulder with a small hip coil; active (0.12) sweeps the arc — spawn the light-trail along the blade and detonate the outer-edge burst at the arc's far end. Recovery re-centres to a guard stance. Cancelable into move after 0.30.

abilityW.animatorNotes: Plant the shield forward. Startup (0.14) snaps the shield up and braces the legs; the guard loop (charge clip) holds while damage is reduced (blend to a strained hold if hit); on release the wave fires — kick the shield forward a few cm and flash the barrier. Upper body on an isolated layer so the character can still be nudged.

abilityE.animatorNotes: Explosive shield-first dash. Short crouch load (0.10), then root-motion lunge covering up to 5 m; on an enemy arrival play a shield-bash contact that displaces (spawn bash VFX on the shield socket). On an ally arrival, skip the bash and slide to a protective stop.

ultimate.animatorNotes: Raise sword and shield skyward then slam the shield to the ground to project the field. Big anticipation (0.35) with a rising camera-worthy pose; on the slam, spawn the dome field and pulse the enemy marks outward. Long recovery sells the weight; super-armor during startup so it reads as a committed team ult.

passive.animatorNotes: Additive ember/armor-plating glow that intensifies per stack on an additive upper-body layer; fades when stacks drop out of combat. No base-pose change.

abilityQ.animatorNotes: Wide two-handed horizontal reap. Heavy back-coil (0.26) plants the rear foot; the sweep drags edge targets inward — emit inward wisps toward Garland during active. Big follow-through past the hip; slow recovery communicates commitment.

abilityW.animatorNotes: Unstoppable shoulder charge. Startup is a braced wind-up loop (charge clip) with an unstoppable aura; on release, root-motion charge ~4.5 m ending in a shoulder-check knockback. Keep the sword low/trailing so the body silhouette leads.

abilityE.animatorNotes: Throw a chain-blade forward (over-the-shoulder toss). On hit it slows; the RECAST clip reels Garland to the target with a short root-motion lunge (author as a separate clip triggered by recast). Keep the throw's off-hand anchored for a believable chain line.

ultimate.animatorNotes: Transformation buff. A one-shot transform-in (0.40) roars and erupts dark energy while a scale/aura blend grows the silhouette; then locomotion/attacks swap to an EMPOWERED layer for the duration (author empowered idle/run/attack variants). Shockwaves fire on a repeating additive event, not the base clip.

passive.animatorNotes: No pose change; a small weapon-glint FX plays each time the ability CLASS changes (handled by the effects system reading the passive). Optionally a subtle stance micro-shift on the additive layer per stack.

abilityQ.animatorNotes: Swap to LANCE for a piercing straight thrust. Quick chamber (0.16) pulls the lance to the hip, then a snappy forward stab; flash the sweet-spot burst at max reach. Weapon swap is instantaneous via the WeaponSocket (hide bow, show lance for the clip's duration).

abilityW.animatorNotes: Draw the BOW and loose a high volley toward the point. Draw-and-hold on startup (0.24), release arcs arrows up; the rain + reveal resolve at the target. Keep the draw arm on an isolated layer so lower body can micro-adjust facing.

abilityE.animatorNotes: Swap to SWORD for a close upward slash that heals. Short step-in, rising diagonal cut; on contact draw life-wisps back into Firion's chest (heal cue). Snappy, low-commitment recovery to keep him kiting.

ultimate.animatorNotes: Summon a storm of spectral weapons that fire in sequence (active loop), ending in a controllable finishing shot. Startup raises the arsenal around him; the loop rapidly projects weapons forward; the finisher is a single big aimed shot — snap to an aiming pose, then release. Player may steer the final shot during the loop.

passive.animatorNotes: No clip; an 'Exposed' mark FX is applied to enemies by the effects system. Optional subtle crown/eye glow additive when a trap is armed nearby.

abilityQ.animatorNotes: Point the staff to inscribe a delayed lightning seal. A commanding downward staff-point on startup places the sigil; the strike resolves after the ability's delay (VFX-driven, not in the body clip). Regal, minimal body travel.

abilityW.animatorNotes: Subtle off-hand gesture that plants a HIDDEN trap (low tell on purpose). Small, quiet cast — a flick of the free hand toward the point; keep animation understated so opponents can't easily read it from silhouette.

abilityE.animatorNotes: Thrust the free palm forward to emit a repelling cone. Body leans back on startup then punches the palm out; sell the recoil in recovery. Cone VFX from the chest/palm; enemies pushed toward prepared zones.

ultimate.animatorNotes: Raise the staff two-handed overhead to conjure a domain. Long theatrical charge (0.45) with the staff aloft and cape flare; on release the domain expands across the target area (bolts + faster trap arming are VFX/gameplay driven). Recovery lowers the staff with menace.

passive.animatorNotes: A colored aura (blue=Ninja bonus ready, gold=Sage bonus ready) on an additive layer that flips when the next opposite-type cast is empowered. No pose change.

abilityQ.animatorNotes: Fast dash-slash. Minimal wind-up, root-motion dart-through ~4 m with a single clean cut; on a reset (marked target/kill) blend instantly back to the same clip via the recast so it reads as a chain. In NINJA stance the dash is longer/faster (scale root motion up).

abilityW.animatorNotes: Two quick hand-casts launching compact bolts. Alternate hands for the two bolts. In SAGE stance widen the stance and add a small back-lean for a 'caster' read; bolts travel further (VFX/gameplay). Sword sheathed for this clip.

abilityE.animatorNotes: Instant stance toggle. A quick spin/flourish that swaps the crystal's color and switches the ACTIVE locomotion+ability layer between Ninja (agile, low stance) and Sage (upright, staff-grip). Very short so it can be woven mid-combo.

ultimate.animatorNotes: Brief empowerment activating BOTH stances. Transform-in flourish summons ghost-images of multiple jobs; for the duration, both Ninja and Sage bonuses apply — drive an empowered dual aura and enable a special finishing recast (author ok_r_finisher). One-shot in, buff layer for uptime.

passive.animatorNotes: Void stacks are FX on the target. Idle floats; the tentacles subtly writhe on an additive layer that grows more agitated at higher stacks.

abilityQ.animatorNotes: Cross the tentacles forward and fire a narrow beam from the chest. Startup gathers void energy (optional charge loop extends range); the active holds the beam pose. Almost no lower-body travel — she floats in place; upper body braces against the beam recoil.

abilityW.animatorNotes: Sweep an arm low to release an advancing floor of void. A slow, graceful arm sweep; the field advances forward (VFX). Keep her serene and imperious — minimal effort read, maximum menace.

abilityE.animatorNotes: Dissolve into a drifting void form (untargetable). Body dissolves to particles and drifts (steerable, slow); no casting allowed during the loop. Re-form on exit. Great for dodging — the silhouette should clearly read as 'intangible' during the drift.

ultimate.animatorNotes: Spread both arms wide, tentacles flared, to open an expanding void zone that reduces vision and detonates stored Void. Grand cruciform pose on the gather; on release the zone blooms outward. Slow, dominant recovery folding the arms back in.

passive.animatorNotes: A Light-gauge glow builds on the chest while in Dark Knight; consumed visibly when Paladin spends it. Additive layer only; base locomotion swaps with the stance layer.

abilityQ.animatorNotes: Stance-dependent cleave. DARK: a brooding downward cleave that costs HP — heavier, hunched. PALADIN: a brighter rising slash. Author BOTH as variants selected by stance; share timing so gameplay stays identical. Dark trail is violet, holy trail is gold.

abilityW.animatorNotes: PALADIN: a protective leap to an ally ending in a shielding guard pose (root-motion ~5 m). DARK: an in-place pressure-aura stomp instead (no travel — gate root motion by stance). The leap's landing plants firmly to sell 'I've got you'.

abilityE.animatorNotes: DARK: stab the sword down to spawn a slow field. PALADIN: point the sword to tether/protect an ally. Same body clip, different weapon glow + VFX by stance.

ultimate.animatorNotes: The signature Dark↔Paladin transformation. A held, cinematic pose (0.50): armor sheds shadow / dons light (or vice-versa), a cleanse burst clears debuffs, and the ACTIVE stance layer swaps. Sell the identity change — this is his hero moment.

passive.animatorNotes: No clip; a speed buff toward isolated enemies. Optionally a faint wind-streak additive when the bonus is active.

abilityQ.animatorNotes: Straight lance thrust that heals vs champions. Chamber the lance to the hip, explosive forward stab, draw a life-wisp back on hit. Crisp and low-commitment.

abilityW.animatorNotes: A short hop OVER terrain with a landing strike. Crouch-load, arc up and forward (root motion clears walls), spear-first landing that hits. Airtime pose reads as a mini-dragoon-jump, foreshadowing the ult.

abilityE.animatorNotes: Throw the lance to mark+slow (then he fights unarmed briefly or pulls a spare — art choice; recommend a quick spectral lance refill on recovery so his hand isn't empty). Over-shoulder javelin throw with full body torque.

ultimate.animatorNotes: The iconic dragoon leap. Deep crouch-load (0.30) then LAUNCH off-screen (untargetable) — hold an airborne loop while the player selects the landing point — then CRASH straight down, lance-first, into a knock-up. Three clips: launch, airborne_loop (charge), crash. Camera-worthy; the airborne window doubles as a dodge.

passive.animatorNotes: No clip; small stat bonuses from item categories. Optional micro-idle variety (weight shifts) to sell his easygoing personality.

abilityQ.animatorNotes: Enchant the blade with a chosen element then a diagonal slash. Startup flares the element along the blade (recolor the trail by element: fire/ice/etc.); the slash bursts on contact. One clip, element-swappable VFX.

abilityW.animatorNotes: A quick mobile bow-shot: a light back-hop (steerable) while loosing an arrow, so he can fire-and-reposition. Swap to bow via WeaponSocket for the clip; snappy and kite-friendly.

abilityE.animatorNotes: A brief defensive stance converting damage to speed. Quick snap into a braced guard loop (charge clip) with a shimmer; on expiry, a small release. Keep it short and readable so enemies know the window.

ultimate.animatorNotes: Cycle three pre-chosen empowered job actions. A quick 'call the jobs' flourish enters the state; each of the three recasts plays a distinct job-action clip (author bartz_r_job_action as a small library keyed by loadout). Personality-forward — a showman's spin between actions.

passive.animatorNotes: While standing still, defense builds and void energy gathers at the feet (additive glow intensifies over time); moving 'spends' it (a brief release FX). Base idle stays planted and imposing.

abilityQ.animatorNotes: Slam or point the greatsword to send a line of dark roots that erupt after a delay. Heavy two-handed downward point on startup; the eruption is delayed (VFX/gameplay). Minimal travel — he's an immovable caster-bruiser.

abilityW.animatorNotes: Raise the free hand and clench to form a well that pulls enemies inward. Slow, deliberate arm raise then a fist-clench that triggers the pull. Weighty, sorcerous, unhurried.

abilityE.animatorNotes: Open a paired portal set with an outward two-hand gesture. Both portals bloom (one at Exdeath, one at the point). Understated body motion — the FX does the talking.

ultimate.animatorNotes: Raise the greatsword to form a great cross of void that patterns the zone with sequential detonations + random debuffs. Long, grand anticipation (0.55) with the blade aloft and cape billow; on release the cross imprints and detonations march outward. Slow, final-boss recovery.
